name: Goa
description: Sun-kissed beaches, vibrant nightlife, and Portuguese heritage blend beautifully along the Arabian Sea.

name: Leh-Ladakh
description: High-altitude desert with dramatic monasteries, crystal lakes, and the world's most scenic mountain passes.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City dazzles with royal palaces, colorful bazaars, and centuries-old Rajput architecture.

name: Kerala Backwaters
description: Glide through tranquil palm-fringed canals on traditional houseboats surrounded by lush greenery.

name: Manali
description: A snow-capped Himalayan retreat offering thrilling adventures, cozy cafes, and pine-scented valleys.

name: Andaman Islands
description: Pristine turquoise waters, coral reefs, and untouched beaches perfect for diving and relaxation.

name: Varanasi
description: The spiritual heart of India with ancient ghats, sacred rivers, and timeless evening aarti rituals.

name: Shillong
description: The Scotland of the East, known for rolling hills, cascading waterfalls, and living root bridges.

name: Rishikesh
description: The yoga capital of the world nestled along the Ganges, perfect for adventure sports and spirituality.
